repairs.detail: Temporal adapter now contains one pair token followed only by dense temporal patch tokens; pooled per-frame tokens were removed.
Padding and tokenizer special IDs are excluded from text-to-patch evidence while the full attention mask remains used by the text tower.
Common-gallery and milestone evaluators default to rerank query batch size 1 after the preserved evaluation-only OOM.

historical_phase_a.reason: The repaired temporal token contract changes the model state dictionary and requires a fresh Phase-A run before any Phase-B initialization.
